caption:
POV: you are the dorm vending machine at 2 a.m.

#collegelife #collegefood #relatable #fyp

beats.say: You're the dorm vending machine. It's two a.m.
beats.title: POV: you're the vending machine

beats.say: Here he comes. Third night in a row.
He has a wrinkled dollar. You reject it. For fun.
beats.cap: He has a wrinkled dollar. You reject it. For *fun.*

beats.say: He smooths it on his leg. He whispers please.
You take it. You give him the pretzels he didn't pick.
Savor Scout dot net. Free him from you.
